methodology.purpose: GPU-to-PSU baseline requirements for PROFITNODE RIG BUILD.
methodology.reference_minimum_psu_w: Vendor/reference whole-system minimum/recommendation where available. It is NOT GPU board power.
methodology.board_power_w: Reference/typical GPU board power (TGP/TBP/TDP-class value). AIB models may differ.
methodology.pn_suggested_zone: A deliberately conservative comfortable wattage range for a quality single-GPU gaming PSU. It is not a substitute for exact whole-system calculation.
important: Exact AIB model specifications override the generic GPU-chip record.
PSU quality, +12V capability, age, transient handling and connector availability matter in addition to headline wattage.
High-draw CPUs or unusual systems can require moving above the PN suggested zone.
NVIDIA and AMD system-power figures are based on particular reference systems; actual requirements can differ.
